newsitem.title: USA: Analyst Gary Black says tobacco to outperform.
newsitem.headline: Analyst Gary Black says tobacco to outperform.

text.p: Bernstein Research analyst Gary Black is rating Philip Morris Cos Inc, RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp and UST Inc as market outperformers as tobacco industry liability talks wind down.

"We continue to expect tobacco stocks to trade up initially after the deal is announced, but then fall back soon after investors take profits, worry about Congress passing the deal, and watch antagonists shoot at the deal," Black said in a statement.

Black believes that elements of the deal, except total payments ranging between $308 billion through $375 billion, have been resolved and that the industry has ceded unconditionally on U.S. Food and Drug Administration regulation on nicotine, in exchange for a ban on punitive damages.
Add-on penalties continuing for 25 years will be on top of the total liability cap, Black said in a research report.

Also, the deal attaches "appropriate multiples" for valuing tobacco stocks, including a total liability cap of $10 billion to $15 billion annually, while tobacco class action lawsuits are banned, Black said.
Black said he would not be surprised if Philip Morris suspended its stock repurchase and declined a dividend increase, since it may give the appearance that the company is profiting too handsomely.
Bernstein Research is a unit of Sanford C. Bernstein & Co Inc.
